newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: EU stymied over Albania move.
newsitem.headline: EU stymied over Albania move.

text.p: Spanish Foreign Minister Abel Matutes said on Saturday there had been no consensus at a meeting of his EU colleagues on whether to provide military assistance to Albania.
"The majority is against," he told reporters.
Matutes said Italy, Greece, Denmark and France had been in favour of military intervention of some sort to restore order in Albania, but that Britain, Germany and Sweden had been vehemently opposed.
Diplomats said the ministers were keen to deliver some sort of civil, political and economic assistance.
A number of proposals had been discussed including the option of establishing a bridgehead to allow aid to enter ports and the idea of sending police advisers.
